description:
Follows BEAM (user decision 2026-11-09). BEAM reserves one literal region (ERTS_LITERAL_VIRTUAL_AREA_SIZE, 1 GiB) and answers "is this a literal?" with one bounds check (erts_is_in_literal_range); the collector copies a pointer only if it is not a literal and not in the old heap (ErtsInYoungGen), and debug builds assert the answer against a second classification. Proposal page: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-gl6.4.html.

Today ptr_in_ranges (runtime/src/heap/ref_io.rs:68) tests each pointer against every from-space range, so a collection of a heap with N grafted gifts costs edges x N (release bench, N three-cell lists: 100 = 2.7x, 1000 = 14x, 10000 = 127x the one-block cost). It exists to recognise off-heap statics.

Requires two predecessors (proposed on the page, filed on approval): static closures and halt continuations become program-wide data objects; and every program has one static area on Node (JIT: an fz memory provider reserving one region for all data objects; AOT: one named section with linker start/stop symbols; interpreter: a small runtime region), holding static struct literals, static closures, halt continuations and the nil slot (NIL_ATOM_REF_SLOT moves there).

This ticket: a heap-kinded pointer, or a scalar ref's storage, is copied unless it lies in Node's static area. Callers: forward.rs cheney_forward_strict_bits (:31), forward_any_value_ref_root scalar (:58), forward_heap_value (:231); deep_copy.rs HeapView::contains (:40) becomes "share if static, copy otherwise"; any_value.rs is_proc_heap_list/map (:1299, :1309) use the same test.

Done when:
- No release-build path walks from_ranges per pointer. ptr_in_ranges / is_active_from_space_object survive only as a debug-build cross-check asserting (a) the static-area answer agrees with the walk and (b) no examined pointer lies in to-space.
- Deleted: GcStats.from_ranges_walked and its telemetry field (always equal to blocks_released); Heap::current_heap_tagged_addr and current_heap_addr_for_kind (no callers); deep_copy_test's other-heap list case (no production path creates one); heap_test's Rust-static scalar case is rewritten to a static-area case.
- A heap unit test grafts many small gifts and collects, asserting every survivor is forwarded and every static-area object is left in place.
- The bench in session scratchpad gl6/t4/bench shows the 10000-gift collection near the one-block cost; record before/after in the commit.
- No fixture pin changes.
- Documentation in the same commit: every .agent/docs page, guide (guides/*.html), README.md section and fixture README that describes a mechanism this ticket changes or removes is rewritten to the present fact in the same commit, and a grep for the old names and phrases over .agent, guides, README.md and fixtures returns nothing. Full gate green (--workspace --all-targets plus doc tests, fixture matrix with --test-threads=1). Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form. No co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: The collector, deep copy and the formatter ask the one static area, not the from-space chain
